title: templatedashboard.update
description: Update existing template dashboards. The dashboardid property must be specified for each dashboard, all other properties are optional; only the specified properties will be updated.

dashboardid.description: ID of the template dashboard to update.

templateid.description: ID of the template the dashboard belongs to.

display_period.description: Default page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 30.

auto_start.description: Auto start slideshow. Possible values: 0 - do not auto start slideshow; 1 - (default) auto start slideshow.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported template dashboards to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given.

pages.description: Template dashboard pages to replace the existing dashboard pages. Dashboard pages are updated by the dashboard_pageid property. New dashboard pages will be created for objects without dashboard_pageid property and the existing dashboard pages will be deleted if not reused. Dashboard pages will be ordered in the same order as specified. Only the specified properties of the dashboard pages will be updated. At least one dashboard page object is required for pages property.

dashboard_pageid.description: ID of the dashboard page. Omit to create a new page.

name.description: Dashboard page name. Default: empty string.

display_period.description: Dashboard page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 0, 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 0 (will use the default page display period).

widgets.description: Array of the template dashboard widget objects.

widgetid.description: ID of the dashboard widget. Omit to create a new widget.

type.description: Type of the dashboard widget. Possible values: clock - Clock; graph - Graph (classic); graphprototype - Graph prototype; item - Item value; plaintext - Plain text; url - URL.

x.description: A horizontal position from the left side of the dashboard. Valid values range from 0 to 23.

y.description: A vertical position from the top of the dashboard. Valid values range from 0 to 62.

width.description: The widget width. Valid values range from 1 to 24.

height.description: The widget height. Valid values range from 2 to 32.

view_mode.description: The widget view mode. Possible values: 0 - (default) default widget view; 1 - with hidden header.

fields.description: Array of the template dashboard widget field objects.

type.description: Type of the widget field. Possible values: 0 - Integer; 1 - String; 4 - Item; 5 - Item prototype; 6 - Graph; 7 - Graph prototype.

value.description: Widget field value depending on type.
